nodes.label:
AI Agent
Workflow Design
nodes.title: AI Agent Workflow Design
nodes.info: Map exactly where the new agent fits into an existing club process and who reviews its output. Skipping this gives you a tool with no owner and no review step.

nodes.label:
AI Agent
Integration Testing
nodes.title: AI Agent Integration Testing
nodes.info: Try the agent on real but low-stakes material before any family sees its output. Skipping this means families are the test.

nodes.label:
AI Agent
Rollout Plan
nodes.title: AI Agent Rollout Plan
nodes.info: Introduce the tested agent gradually -- one mentor first, not the whole club at once. Skipping this turns one bad assumption into a club-wide problem.

nodes.label:
AI Agent Training
for Leaders
nodes.title: AI Agent Training for Leaders
nodes.info: Teach every mentor who will use it how to prompt it well and what its guardrails and quirks are. Skipping this produces inconsistent output blamed on the tool.

nodes.label:
Coaching Leaders
With AI
nodes.title: Coaching Leaders With AI
nodes.info: An ongoing agent-assisted coaching layer for the club's own leadership, drawing on retrospective notes over time.
